finding.text: The diff's real change is only `ChatV2.test.mjs` plus one `.gitignore` line: the live copy is now `live-<pid>.jsonl`, written into the tree the site at `base` serves, so a worktree run no longer 404s on `?src=`. The logic reads correct (`argv[2] || !main_tree` picks this checkout when a url is given), and `rmSync(copy)` at the end still cleans up.

About 25 other files in the diff are `files.jsonl` machine-state lines (many `"gone":true`) from unrelated modules, plus `fixture/files.jsonl` recording `live-3020.jsonl`; they are not part of the fix and add review noise.

`ext/Chat/v2/readme.md` does not mention the per-run `fixture/live-*` copy or that the test writes into the main tree when run from a worktree; one line there would help a fresh agent understand why a killed run leaves a file (the `.gitignore` comment covers only git).
No ask in `requirements.md` is touched (this is a test-harness fix for step 1's proof), so none is newly met or broken; `mkdirSync` imported at ChatV2.test.mjs:3 may now be unused.

No screenshot or test shows the ✦ sheet with the v2 chip on (requirements step 2 asks for the toggle in the sheet; the task rule asks for 390 and a review shot) — the only shots under chat-v2/ are the Chat tab (`tab/shots/chatv2-tab-390.png`, `-400`, `-1200`) and the standalone page (`in-place/shots-chat/chat-v2-390.png`); nothing proves `Sheet.js sync_v2()` draws, hides `.ux-dictate-widget-thread`, or follows New session.

The task folder cannot be continued alone: `session.jsonl` ends with "session resumed" and has no log line saying the sheet mount landed, its commit hash, how to try it (open ✦ on a phone width, tap "v2"), or that the parent was told; the Done-when boxes in `requirements.md` are unticked.

`ext/drawer/readme.md` (the Sheet.js / rail.css bullet, line ~32) does not mention the new v2 chip, its `localStorage` key `lew42.sheet.chat_view`, or that Sheet.js now imports `ext/Chat/v2/ChatV2.js`; only `doc/sheet.md` and the Chat v2 readme do, so a fresh agent reading the drawer readme will not find it. `ext/Chat/readme.md:31` also still describes v2 as "read only", which is stale now that writers and the sheet mount exist.

`Sheet.js:403-408` `sync_v2()` calls `this.chat_v2?.unsubscribe()` right after `new ChatV2(...).live()`, but `JSONL.live()` is async (`Store.record_url(...).then(stream)`); a quick New session or toggle before it resolves may leave a stream open. Worth one headless check.

`rail.css` hides the thread with `display:none` and prepends the v2 box into `.ux-dictate-widget-card`, so v1 keeps running (and keeps its DOM) under v2; acceptable for a compare toggle, and v1 stays untouched as required.

The fixed CSS `font-size: 0.8em` and `padding: 0.3em 0.7em` on the chip at `rail.css:~329` are literal values rather than the clamp/space tokens the css skill asks for; check it with the css questions.
